LightningComponentBundle.description: Responsive branding image from the HeaderFooter static resource. Add an instance to each desired site region.

property.name: alternativeText
property.label: Image alternative text
property.description: Describe the image for screen readers. Leave blank for a decorative image.

property.name: imagePath
property.label: Image path inside ZIP (optional)
property.description: Leave blank for a single image resource. For a ZIP resource, enter the relative image path, such as images/header.png.
